```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```



```{r library}
library(tidyverse)
```



```{r readin}
cases_year <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2025/2025-06-24/cases_year.csv') 
health <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-09-29/health.csv') 
```


```{r join}
cases_2025 <- cases_year %>%
  filter(year == "2025")

health_name <- health %>%
  rename(country = GC_CNT_GAD_2025) %>%
  filter(country %in% cases_2025$country)

merged_cases_2025 <- full_join(cases_2025, health_name, by = "country")
```
